verdict.rationale: Codex CLI can inspect code, run local dev tools and commands, and run a dedicated review against changes to surface findings, which supports diagnosing issues and verifying fixes in a real dev environment (codex-docs-9, codex-docs-8, codex-docs-10, codex-docs-19). However, there's no explicit documented workflow for reproducing bugs or verifying fixes end-to-end, and community feedback is mixed on real-world reliability for hard debugging tasks. Missing for 10: explicit bug-reproduction/root-cause workflow documentation, independent hands-on confirmation of successful debug-and-verify cycles.
